mode: Built-in imagegen, reference-preserving atlas edit; runtime SVG articulation and facial expressions.

files.original:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production animation texture atlas for the VELO SOUL mobile AR companion.
Input image is the identity and material reference. Preserve the same recognizable color, friendly face, glossy translucent 3D jelly material and signature accessory. Lumi: vivid cobalt-blue translucent jelly ghost, very large curious dark eyes, white aviator goggles on its head. Sixth cell: one small blue and white sparkle.
Create ONE landscape PNG sprite-part atlas with a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, not white and not a painted checkerboard. Exact regular layout: THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, all six cells evenly sized, no borders or labels. Parts must stay entirely inside their own cells with ample transparent margin. Each isolated part is centered in its cell and faces the camera, lit consistently from upper left.
Top row: (1) the complete head-and-body core with the face and head accessory and soft ghost-tail silhouette, but ABSOLUTELY NO ARMS, HANDS, LEGS OR FEET; fill 80% of this cell height. (2) a separate left arm plus a cute rounded mitten hand, wrist connected to upper arm, no detached fingers, fill about 65% cell height. (3) a separate right arm plus matching hand, mirrored pose, fill about 65% cell height.
Bottom row: (4) separate left short stubby leg with a rounded little foot, matching jelly material, fill about 60% cell height. (5) separate right short leg and rounded foot, mirrored, fill 60% cell height. (6) the isolated accessory specified above, fill 65% cell width.
These pieces will be combined in code and their hand/foot joints animated individually. The core must have a clean uninterrupted torso where arms were removed. No duplicate limbs on core, no extra characters, no cast shadows beneath the parts, no text, no background scene. Premium charming 3D game-render quality, smooth antialiased alpha edges.
files.edit: Precise edit of attached production character animation atlas, lumi. Preserve the exact 1536x1024 canvas layout and all six parts in their existing positions and sizes, glossy 3D translucent jelly material, signature head accessory, colors and shape. Make only these required changes: 1) On the upper-left body core, REMOVE ALL EYES, EYEBROWS AND MOUTH. Reconstruct smooth uninterrupted colored jelly material in their places. The face is a blank smooth surface for programmatic animated eyes and mouth to be overlaid later. Keep head accessory, highlights and cheek blush. 2) REMOVE ALL external glow, haze, black backdrop, cast shadows and grid lines from all six cells. The empty space must be genuinely fully transparent alpha. Crisp antialiased object edges and fully opaque object centers. No environmental glow outside any object. Keep arms, feet and lower-right prop as separate pieces. Do not combine parts. Do not change crop or layout. Do not add any new details or text.
